candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations between adjacent bits. Replacing XOR with AND breaks the conversion, causing incorrect binary values to be generated from the Gray code input.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations between adjacent bits (step 2 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion should use XOR operations between the binary value and its right-shifted version. Replacing XOR with OR breaks the conversion, causing incorrect Gray code sequences.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires converting binary back to Gray code using XOR operations between the binary value and its right-shifted version (step 4 of the process)

candidates.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should XOR each bit with the immediately more significant converted bit. Using bit 3 instead of bit 2 breaks the conversion chain.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires proper chaining of XOR operations in Gray-to-binary conversion (step 2 of the process)
